decisions.Q1_numbers: The seven (views, likes, comments, shares, saves, shop taps, added to bag) plus finished for a video post
decisions.Q2_window: All-time since the post went live, counted at read; not the feed's 30-day roll-up
decisions.Q3_comments: In this contract: creator reads, replies, hides/unhides; brand reads; removed by INFLX is final
decisions.Q4_brand_website: Not in this contract; a later Level 3 + 4 website contract
decisions.Q5_order: Money row first (as Level 3 locked it), then In INFLX, then On social media, then by channel
decisions.Q6_notifications: No new-comment card on Home / Needs You in this contract
decisions.Q7_set_posts_row: The In INFLX line on each Set posts row, under visits/orders, above the social line
decisions.Q8_delete_own_reply: No delete of her own reply; hiding the shopper's comment hides the thread
decisions.Q9_guests: Guests count for views, shares, shop taps, added to bag and finished; likes, comments, saves are accounts only
decisions.Q10_own_brand: Item 20 own-brand posts included; he replies as the creator
